execution_scope: Uncommitted integration worktree above the base; per-run exact full tree hashes were not captured. Logs are point-in-time local evidence, not final-head CI acceptance.
timestamps: Source mtime is filesystem metadata, not an independently authenticated test execution timestamp. Embedded log timestamps are preserved where present.
hashes: source_sha256 hashes the original saved log; copied_sha256 hashes the reviewed/normalized artifact. Hashes bind evidence bytes, not a missing execution tree.
